routines.name: BSP_SceneFile_ReadTrafficBlock

routines.name: BSP_SceneFile_ReadBrowserGroupEntry
routines.evidence: 62 instructions read in full. Eleven ExpectToken calls in fixed order for 'BrowserGroup' '{' 'GroupName' '=' ... 'GroupID' '=' ... 'Parent' '=' ... '}'. The first instruction to touch ECX is MOV ECX,ESI at 00469512, after MOV ESI,[ESP+24h] loads the tokenizer. Nothing is stored: the two strings go to stack locals freed at 004695cc and 004695f3, and ReadInt's destination LEA EAX,[ESP+24h] at 0046956e is entry+4, the caller's dead tokenizer argument slot that the RET 4 pops.

corrections.was: `traffic` | 00CE5890 | 009514B0 (pass 3) / 0095CA10 (pass 2, then stop) | not read | not decoded
corrections.is: 009514B0 is a brace counter around the single production `item`; 0095CA10 skips nothing. It is 14 instructions with no tokenizer reference that drain the intrusive list at 00F8A0B0 into 0095C640. In the registration pass the traffic body is never tokenized at all.
corrections.evidence: the full listings of 009514B0 and 0095CA10; 0046eb3d JNZ 0046ebdd is the pass gate.

corrections.was: `SceneBrowserGroups` | 00CE56A4 | 00469E40 | repeats 004694F0, one entry per iteration; the entry layout was not read
corrections.is: the entry is `BrowserGroup { GroupName = TOKEN GroupID = INT Parent = TOKEN }` and neither routine stores it. 004694F0 never reads ECX, frees both strings before returning, and writes the parsed GroupID into the caller's dead argument slot.
corrections.evidence: 004694F0's 62 instructions; the ReadInt destination LEA EAX,[ESP+24h] at 0046956e resolves to entry+4 with the frame at entry-0x20.

corrections.was: the .props library loader 008F67B0 is what supplies a registry, for the parenthesised parent in `properties Ship(Common)` (stated as the expected answer, not read)
corrections.is: confirmed, and the registry it supplies is the CPropTreeLibrary itself: 008f6ad1 pushes [ESP+28h], which 008f67d6 set from the entry ECX. Argument 2 is 0 where an entity block passes 1, so a parent loses to the child.

corrections.was: 008F5A00's remaining callers 008F67B0 and 009512F0 were not read
corrections.is: both are read here. 009512F0 is the traffic item reader, not an entity block reader; its bag is applied to a 4Ch traffic record by 0049CF80 and destroyed.

divergences: read_traffic_item hands the host a finished record where the native creates it at 00951396 and applies properties to it at 009513e8, so a bag that failed mid-parse would leave a half-applied record in the native's vector.
apply_traffic_properties drops a templates child whose name is in neither enum table; the native has no miss arm and takes whatever 0048E840 returns.
load_prop_library_file consumes an unrecognised top-level token; 008F67B0 consumes nothing there and would spin. No shipped file has one.
The float type test uses the authored type letter because a ScenePropertyBlock carries the letter, not the resolved type code the native compares against 1.
